messages.subject: HTML within input labels
parts:
On a checkboxGroupInput, I would like to include a little html snippet on certain checkbox items.  I figured I could just plug the html into the names() of the choices vector.  I tried many different versions using htmlOutput, uiOutput, HTML, etc, but could not get this to work.

Basically the HTML is being escaped.  Here is a screenshot of what I keep ending up with:



Here is my replicable example

runApp(list(
  ui = bootstrapPage(
    uiOutput("forminput")
  ),
  server = function(input,output) {
    output$forminput = renderUI({
      x = letters[1:10]
      names(x) = x
      names(x)[1] = paste(x[1], "<span class='blah'>This</span>")
      checkboxGroupInput("testing","Testing",x)
    })
  }
))


Will this be possible?
